---

New behavior, not a fix for broken behavior. If something already exists and
works wrong, use the bug report instead.

**What you want**

Describe the feature in plain terms, from the player's side. What can you do
after this ships that you cannot do now?

**Why it matters**

The problem underneath the request. What are you doing today to work around its
absence? Concrete beats general; one real turn where you needed this is more
useful than a category of benefit.

**Who it helps**

New players, veterans, people running a game, people playing an AI seat, or
everyone. Say which, and be honest if it mostly helps you.

**Alternatives you considered**

Other ways to solve the same problem, including smaller versions of this idea
and doing nothing. If a smaller version would get you most of the way, say so;
small things ship.

**Does it change the rules**

- [ ] No. This is interface, quality of life, or presentation.
- [ ] Yes. This changes game behavior or balance.

Rules changes are held to a higher bar. Galaxies runs on the Stars! Nova
engine, and turn resolution needs to stay deterministic and fair to everyone in
a game, including players who are not reading this issue.

**Anything else**

Sketches, screenshots, links to how another game handles it, prior discussion.

A note on scope, honestly. This is a small project and most requests sit for a
while before anything happens. Filing one is not a promise from us that it
ships, and it is not a waste of your time either; the list is read.
